decisions.base: Complete 150-card base checklist; each Base card has equal VCS draw probability.
decisions.rookies: Append RC only to the 10 independently verified TCDB true rookie cards.
decisions.inserts: TCDB lists no pack-issued inserts or parallels.
decisions.promos: Exclude separately listed promotional cards, which are not regular pack issues.
decisions.variants: Collapse errors/uncorrected errors into one card identity; do not import annotation text as player.
decisions.playerNames: Only remove metadata tokens when separated from the player's name by whitespace or clear delimiters. Preserve legitimate surname endings.
decisions.release: Keep unreleased until checklist/team/rookie QA, card art, pricing, and pack visual review.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: All 150 numbered base subjects have equal pull odds; ten independently verified RCs.
